source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 24 (PDF 118-133), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Organic nitrogen compounds form the basis of life in the form of:
(Organic nitrogen compounds zindagi ki bunyaad kis shakal mein banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Organic nitrogen compounds amino acids aur nucleotides ki shakal mein zindagi ki bunyaad hain, jin se proteins bante hain (24.1).

book_ref.quote: They form the basis of life in the form of amino acids and nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
2 Nylon, Kevlar® and polyurethane, found in every home and office, are:
(Nylon, Kevlar® aur polyurethane, jo har ghar aur office mein milte hain, kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter nylon, Kevlar® aur polyurethane ko nitrogen wale polymers kehta hai (24.1).

book_ref.quote: Nylon, Kevlar®, and polyurethane are the nitrogen containing polymers

blocks.prompt:
3 Caffeine in coffee and theobromine in chocolate are both:
(Coffee ki caffeine aur chocolate ki theobromine dono kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interesting Information box ke mutabiq caffeine aur theobromine dono organic nitrogen compounds hain (24.1).

book_ref.quote: Caffeine in coffee and theobromine in chocolate both are organic nitrogen compounds

blocks.prompt:
4 Amines are considered as organic derivatives of:
(Amines ko kis ke organic derivatives (makhooz) samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amines mein alkyl ya aryl groups ammonia ke aik, do ya teen hydrogen atoms ki jagah le lete hain (24.1).

book_ref.quote: Amines are considered as organic derivatives of ammonia

blocks.prompt:
5 Amines are classified as primary, secondary and tertiary on the basis of:
(Amines ko primary, secondary aur tertiary kis buniyaad par taqseem kiya jata hai?)

options.text: sab se lambi chain mein carbon atoms ki tadaad
ammonia ke kitne hydrogen atoms alkyl ya aryl groups se badle gaye
molecule mein nitrogen atoms ki tadaad
–NH₂ group wale carbon atom ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Ammonia ke kitne H atoms alkyl ya aryl groups se badle gaye, isi par classification hoti hai (24.1).

book_ref.quote: The number of hydrogen atoms replaced by alky or aryl groups provides a foundation

blocks.prompt:
6 In the IUPAC system, amines are named as:
(IUPAC nizaam mein amines ko kya naam diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: IUPAC naam dene ke nizaam mein amines ko alkanamines kehte hain, maslan methanamine, ethanamine (24.1).

book_ref.quote: In IUPAC nomenclature system, amines are referred to as alkanamines

blocks.prompt:
7 Which one of the following is a primary amine?
(In mein se kaun si primary amine hai?)
blocks.explanation: Propan-1-amine mein –NH₂ par aik alkyl group hai, is liye yeh primary hai; baqi secondary ya tertiary hain (24.1).

book_ref.quote: Primary amines: methanamine, ethanamine, propan-1-amine and phenyl amine (aniline)

blocks.prompt:
8 Diphenyl amine is an example of a:
(Diphenyl amine kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diphenyl amine mein NH group se do aryl groups jure hain, is liye yeh secondary amine hai (24.1).

book_ref.quote: Secondary amines: N-methylmethanamine, N-methylethanamine and diphenyl amine

blocks.prompt:
9 In a secondary amine such as N-methylmethanamine, the nitrogen atom carries:
(N-methylmethanamine jaisi secondary amine mein nitrogen atom par kya hota hai?)

options.text: do carbon groups aur do hydrogen atoms
aik carbon group aur do hydrogen atoms
do carbon groups aur aik hydrogen atom (–NH–)
teen carbon groups aur koi hydrogen atom nahi

blocks.explanation: Secondary amines mein do alkyl ya aryl groups NH group se jure hote hain, is liye N par sirf aik H hai: CH₃–NH–CH₃ (24.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: In secondary amines, two alky or aryl groups are attached to NH group

blocks.prompt:
10 The formula of N,N-dimethylmethanamine is:
(N,N-dimethylmethanamine ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: N,N-dimethylmethanamine (trimethylamine) mein aik nitrogen par teen methyl groups hain: (CH₃)₃N, tertiary amine (24.1).

book_ref.quote: Tertiary amines: N,N-dimethylmethanamine and triphenylamine

blocks.prompt:
11 Triphenylamine is classified as a tertiary amine because:
(Triphenylamine ko tertiary amine kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: teen aryl groups aik hi nitrogen atom se jure hain
is mein teen nitrogen atoms hain
is ka nitrogen tertiary carbon atom se jura hai

blocks.explanation: Tertiary amines mein teen alkyl ya aryl groups aik hi nitrogen atom se jure hote hain (24.1).

book_ref.quote: In tertiary amines, three alkyl or aryl groups are attached to the same nitrogen atom

blocks.prompt:
12 Tetramethylammonium chloride, (CH₃)₄N⁺Cl⁻, is a:
(Tetramethylammonium chloride, (CH₃)₄N⁺Cl⁻, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar groups wale nitrogen derivatives ko quaternary ammonium salts kehte hain (24.1).

book_ref.quote: Tetra-substituted nitrogen derivatives are also known, and are termed as quaternary ammonium salts

blocks.prompt:
13 Whether an amine is primary, secondary or tertiary is decided by the branching at:
(Amine primary, secondary ya tertiary hai, yeh kis jagah ki branching se tay hota hai?)

options.text: benzene ring ke saath wala carbon atom

blocks.explanation: Amines mein nitrogen atom par branching class tay karti hai, alcohols ya alkyl halides ki tarah nahi (24.1).

book_ref.quote: the branching takes place at the nitrogen atom, rather than at the carbon atom attached to it

blocks.prompt:
14 The reaction of a halogenoalkane with ammonia to give a primary amine is a:
(Halogenoalkane aur ammonia se primary amine banne wala reaction kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary amines halogenoalkanes aur ammonia ke nucleophilic substitution reactions se banti hain (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Primary amines can be prepared by the nucleophilic substitution reactions of halogenoalkanes with ammonia

blocks.prompt:
15 In preparing a primary amine from a halogenoalkane, excess ethanolic ammonia under pressure is used to:
(Halogenoalkane se primary amine banate waqt ethanolic ammonia zyada miqdaar mein aur pressure ke saath kyun li jati hai?)

options.text: halogenoalkane ko zyada volatile banane ke liye
secondary amines ya products ka mixture banne se bachne ke liye
amine ko amide mein badalne ke liye
halogen ko gas ki shakal mein nikalne ke liye

blocks.explanation: Zyada ethanolic ammonia pressure ke saath secondary amines ya products ke mixture ko banne se rokti hai (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Excess of ethanolic ammonia under pressure is used to avoid the formation of secondary amines

blocks.prompt:
16 When a halogenoalkane is in excess over ammonia, the major product is:
(Jab halogenoalkane ammonia se zyada ho to bara product kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₃ zyada ho to bara product primary amine; halogenoalkane zyada ho to tertiary amine (24.2).

book_ref.quote: if halogenoalkane is in excess, tertiary amine is the major product

blocks.prompt:
17 Bromoethane reacts with excess ethanolic ammonia under high pressure to give:
(Bromoethane zyada ethanolic ammonia ke saath high pressure par kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂Br + NH₃ (zyada) → CH₃CH₂NH₂ (ethanamine), aik primary amine (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Bromoethane and excess ammonia give ethanamine

blocks.prompt:
18 Reduction of propanenitrile with H₂/Ni or LiAlH₄ gives:
(Propanenitrile ko H₂/Ni ya LiAlH₄ se reduce karne par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanenitriles ko reduce kar ke primary amines banti hain: CH₃CH₂CN → CH₃CH₂CH₂NH₂ (propan-1-amine) (24.2).

book_ref.quote: propanenitrile is reduced with H₂/Ni or LiAlH₄ ro prepare propane-1-amine

blocks.prompt:
19 Nitroethane is reduced with LiAlH₄ to form:
(Nitroethane LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar kya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitroalkanes LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar primary amines banate hain; nitroethane se ethanamine banti hai (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Nitroalkanes are reduced in the presence of LiAlH₄ resulting in the formation of primary amines

blocks.prompt:
20 Reduction of alkanamides by LiAlH₄ gives primary amines in good yield because:
(LiAlH₄ se alkanamides ki reduction mein primary amines achhi yield (paidawar) mein kyun milti hain?)

options.text: reaction paani mein kiya jata hai
amide aik carbon atom kho deti hai
is reaction mein koi byproduct nahi banta

blocks.explanation: Alkanamides LiAlH₄ se achhi yield mein primary amines banati hain kyun ke koi zimni product (byproduct) nahi banta (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Alkanamides are reduced by LiAlH₄ to form primary amines in good yield

blocks.prompt:
21 The Hofmann reaction of propanamide (CH₃CH₂CONH₂) gives:
(Propanamide (CH₃CH₂CONH₂) ka Hofmann reaction kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hofmann reaction amide se aik carbon kam wali amine deta hai: 3 carbon wali amide se 2 carbon wali ethanamine (24.2).

book_ref.quote: This reaction yields the amine with one carbon less than the starting amide.

blocks.prompt:
22 Methanamine reacts with bromoethane in ethanol under pressure to form:
(Methanamine bromoethane ke saath ethanol mein pressure par kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary amine ki halogenoalkane se alkylation secondary amine deti hai: CH₃NH₂ + CH₃CH₂Br → CH₃NHCH₂CH₃ (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Secondary amines can be prepared by the alkylation of primary amines

blocks.prompt:
23 Secondary amines can be prepared by the reduction of:
(Secondary amines kis ki reduction se banai ja sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: N-substituted amides ki reduction secondary amines deti hai, maslan N-methylethanamide → N-methylethanamine (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Secondary amines are also prepared by the reduction of N-substituted amides

blocks.prompt:
24 In the reduction CH₃CONHCH₃ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃, the balanced equation uses:
(Reduction CH₃CONHCH₃ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ ki balanced equation mein kya istemal hota hai?)

options.text: sirf H₂, aur paani nahi banta
H₂, aur oxygen kharij hoti hai

blocks.explanation: CH₃CONHCH₃ + 2H₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + H₂O; C=O ki oxygen paani ban kar nikal jati hai (24.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Reduction of N-methylethanamide to N-methylethanamine

blocks.prompt:
25 Phenylamine can be prepared from chlorobenzene by:
(Chlorobenzene se phenylamine kis tareeqe se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorobenzene ki ammonolysis (ammonia se reaction) phenylamine deti hai (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Ammonylsis is a reaction in which an ammonia molecule is broken down

blocks.prompt:
26 Reduction of nitrobenzene gives:
(Nitrobenzene ki reduction se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenylamine nitrobenzene ki reduction se bhi banai ja sakti hai (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Phenyl amine can also be prepared by the reduction of nitrobenzene

blocks.prompt:
27 Which amide gives phenylamine in the Hofmann reaction?
(Kaun si amide Hofmann reaction mein phenylamine deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenylamine benzamide, C₆H₅CONH₂, ke Hofmann reaction se banti hai (aik carbon kam ho jata hai) (24.2).

book_ref.quote: Hofmann reaction of benzamide

blocks.prompt:
28 Water-soluble amines form weakly alkaline solutions because they:
(Paani mein hal hone wali amines halka alkaline mehlool kyun banati hain?)

options.text: paani mein H⁺ ions chhorti hain
paani se juzwi react kar ke OH⁻ ions banati hain
paani se mukammal react kar ke H₃O⁺ banati hain
toot kar nitrogen gas deti hain

blocks.explanation: Ammonia ki tarah yeh paani se juzwi (partially) react karti hain: RNH₂ + H₂O ⇌ RNH₃⁺ + OH⁻ (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The amines which are soluble in water form weakly alkine solutions

blocks.prompt:
29 The basicity of amines depends on:
(Amines ki basicity kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: nitrogen par lone pair electrons ki dastyabi
molecule mein carbon atoms ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: Basicity is par munhasir hai ke nitrogen ka lone pair proton ke liye kitna dastyab hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The basicity of amines depends on the availability of the “lone pair” of electrons on the nitrogen atom

blocks.prompt:
30 A stronger base has:
(Zyada taqatwar base ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kb jitna bara (ya pKb jitna chhota) ho, base utni taqatwar hoti hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The Larger the Kb (or smaller the pKb), the stronger is the base

blocks.prompt:
31 Alkyl groups attached to the nitrogen atom of an amine:
(Amine ke nitrogen se jure alkyl groups kya karte hain?)

options.text: electrons khenchte hain aur basicity kam karte hain
electrons dete hain aur basicity barhate hain
electrons dete hain aur basicity kam karte hain
basicity par koi asar nahi karte

blocks.explanation: Electron dene wale alkyl groups basicity barhate hain; electron khenchne wale groups ise kam karte hain (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: electron-donating alkyl groups attached to the nitrogen atom increase the basicity of amines

blocks.prompt:
32 According to the chapter, a stronger base is mostly also a stronger:
(Chapter ke mutabiq zyada taqatwar base aksar kis cheez mein bhi zyada taqatwar hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Basicity aksar compound ke zyada nucleophilic kirdaar ki nishani hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Basicity is also an indicator of the stronger nucleophilic character of a compound, mostly

blocks.prompt:
33 From Table 24.1, the correct order of basic strength is:
(Table 24.1 se basic taqat ki sahi tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: pKb values: ethanamine 3.29 < ammonia 4.75 < phenylamine 9.38; sab se chhota pKb sab se taqatwar base (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 24.1 The basicity of some amines

blocks.prompt:
34 The pKb of ethanamine given in Table 24.1 is:
(Table 24.1 mein ethanamine ka pKb kitna diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanamine ka Kb = 5.1 × 10⁻⁴ aur pKb = 3.29 hai; 4.75 ammonia ka hai (24.3.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Its own Table 24.1 gives ethanamine pKb = 3.29

blocks.prompt:
35 The Kb of phenylamine (aniline) in Table 24.1 is:
(Table 24.1 mein phenylamine (aniline) ka Kb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenylamine ka Kb = 4.2 × 10⁻¹⁰ (pKb = 9.38) hai, table ki sab se kamzor base (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 24.1 The basicity of some amines

blocks.prompt:
36 Using Kb values from Table 24.1 (ethanamine 5.1 × 10⁻⁴, ammonia 1.8 × 10⁻⁵), ethanamine is a stronger base than ammonia by a factor of about:
(Table 24.1 ki Kb values (ethanamine 5.1 × 10⁻⁴, ammonia 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) se ethanamine ammonia se taqriban kitne guna taqatwar base hai?)

book_ref.quote: Its own Table 24.1 gives ethanamine pKb = 3.29 (Kb = 5.1 × 10⁻⁴)

blocks.prompt:
37 An amine has Kb = 1.0 × 10⁻⁴. Taking pKb = –log Kb, its pKb is:
(Aik amine ka Kb = 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ hai. pKb = –log Kb le kar is ka pKb kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: pKb = –log(1.0 × 10⁻⁴) = 4.00; yeh ammonia (pKb 4.75) se thori taqatwar hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The Larger the Kb (or smaller the pKb), the stronger is the base

blocks.prompt:
38 Phenylamine is a weaker base than ammonia because:
(Phenylamine ammonia se kamzor base kyun hai?)

options.text: nitrogen ka lone pair benzene ring par phail (delocalise) jata hai
phenylamine ke nitrogen par lone pair nahi
benzene ring nitrogen ko electrons deti hai
phenylamine acids mein bilkul hal nahi hoti

blocks.explanation: Phenylamine mein nitrogen ka lone pair benzene ring par phail jata hai, is liye proton ke liye kam dastyab hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: in phenylamine, the lone pair of electrons on the nitrogen atom is delocalized over the benzene ring

blocks.prompt:
39 In phenylamine (Figure 24.1), the lone pair of the planar nitrogen atom is in:
(Phenylamine (Figure 24.1) mein planar nitrogen ka lone pair kis mein hota hai?)

options.text: ring se door sp³ orbital mein
p orbital mein jo ring ke delocalised π electrons se overlap karta hai

blocks.explanation: Nitrogen planar hai aur lone pair p orbital mein hai jo ring ke phaile hue π electrons se overlap karta hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The nitrogen atom is planar, with its lone pair in a p orbital

blocks.prompt:
40 When ethanamine reacts with hydrogen chloride, the bond formed between nitrogen and the proton is a:
(Ethanamine jab hydrogen chloride se react karti hai to nitrogen aur proton ke darmiyan kaun sa bond banta hai?)

options.text: do anions ke darmiyan ionic bond

blocks.explanation: Nitrogen apna electron pair proton ko deta hai, dative bond banta hai aur salt CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺Cl⁻ banta hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the nitrogen atom donates an electron pair to form a dative bond with a proton

blocks.prompt:
41 Lemon juice sprinkled on fish makes it less smelly because:
(Machhli par lemon juice chhirakne se us ki boo kam kyun ho jati hai?)

options.text: citric acid machhli ki protein ko oxidise karta hai
citric acid basic amine (trimethylamine) se react karta hai
lemon juice machhli ka tel hal kar deta hai
amine juice ke paani se react kar ke amide banati hai

blocks.explanation: Boo trimethylamine ki hai; lemon juice ka citric acid is base se react kar ke kam boo wala salt banata hai (24.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The foul smell from fish is due to N,N– dimethylmathanamine (trimethylamine)

blocks.text: 24.3.2 Distinction between Primary and Secondary Amines

blocks.prompt:
42 Primary, secondary and tertiary aliphatic amines are distinguished by their reaction with:
(Primary, secondary aur tertiary aliphatic amines mein farq kis ke reaction se kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aliphatic amines ki pehchaan nitric(III) acid, HNO₂, se reaction kar ke ki jati hai (24.3.2).

book_ref.quote: are identified and distinguished by reacting them with nitric (III) acid (nitrous acid)

blocks.prompt:
43 The formation of diazonium salts from primary amines and nitrous acid is called:
(Primary amines aur nitrous acid se diazonium salts banne ke amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Primary amines nitrous acid se diazonium salts banati hain; is amal ko diazotization kehte hain (24.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Primary amines react with nitrous acid to form diazonium salts

blocks.prompt:
44 On adding nitrous acid, which amine shows bubbles of nitrogen gas?
(Nitrous acid dalne par kaun si amine nitrogen gas ke bulbulay dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf primary amines nitrous acid se N₂ ke bulbulay deti hain; propan-1-amine primary hai (24.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Primary amines react with nitrous acid to produce nitrogen gas (seen as bubbles)

blocks.prompt:
45 A secondary amine reacts with nitrous acid to form:
(Secondary amine nitrous acid se react kar ke kya banati hai?)

options.text: diazonium salt aur nitrogen ke bulbulay
hal hone wala nitrite salt, koi nazar aane wali tabdeeli nahi

blocks.explanation: Secondary amines N-nitrosoamines banati hain jo peela tel jaisa maaya (yellow oily liquid) nazar aata hai (24.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Secondary amines form N-nitrosoamines (yellow oily liquid) on reaction with nitrous acid

blocks.prompt:
46 When nitrous acid is added to a tertiary amine:
(Tertiary amine mein nitrous acid dalne par kya hota hai?)

options.text: peela tel jaisa maaya alag hota hai
hal hone wala nitrite salt banta hai aur reaction ki koi nishani nazar nahi aati

blocks.explanation: Tertiary amines hal hone wale nitrite salts banati hain; reaction ki koi nazar aane wali nishani nahi hoti (24.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Tertiary amines react with nitrous acid to form soluble nitrite salts

blocks.prompt:
47 Ethanamine reacts with nitrous acid (with HCl) to give, first of all:
(Ethanamine nitrous acid (HCl ke saath) se react kar ke sab se pehle kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanamine, aik primary amine, diazotize ho kar ethane diazonium chloride banati hai jo N₂ chhorta hai (24.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Ethanamine and nitrous acid give ethane diazonium chloride

blocks.prompt:
48 An unknown amine gives a yellow oily liquid with nitrous acid. It could be:
(Aik na-maloom amine nitrous acid se peela tel jaisa maaya deti hai. Yeh kaun si ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peela tel jaisa N-nitrosoamine secondary amine ki nishani hai, maslan N-methylethanamine (24.3.2).

book_ref.quote: N-methylethanamine and nitrous acid give an N-nitrosoamine

blocks.prompt:
49 The two types of reactions of phenylamine are due to:
(Phenylamine ke do qisam ke reactions kis ki wajah se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Phenylamine benzene ring ki wajah se aur –NH₂ group ki wajah se react karti hai (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Phenylamine gives two types of reactions:

blocks.prompt:
50 Since the nitrogen of phenylamine is planar with its lone pair in a p orbital, its hybridisation is taken as:
(Phenylamine ka nitrogen planar hai aur us ka lone pair p orbital mein hai, is liye us ki hybridisation kya maani jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Planar nitrogen jis ka lone pair p orbital mein ho sp² hybridised hota hai, ring ke carbons ki tarah (24.3.3, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Hybridisation in phenylamine: sp2 ring carbons and the nitrogen atom

blocks.prompt:
51 In electrophilic substitution of phenylamine, the –NH₂ group directs the incoming electrophile to:
(Phenylamine ki electrophilic substitution mein –NH₂ group aane wale electrophile ko kahan bhejta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amino group ortho-para directing hai, is liye electrophile o aur p positions par hamla karta hai (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: The amino group (–NH₂) is an ortho-para directing group

blocks.prompt:
52 Phenylamine reacts with bromine water to give:
(Phenylamine bromine water se react kar ke kya deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono ortho aur para position aik hi reaction mein brominate ho jati hain, 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine banti hai (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Bromination of phenylamine to 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine

blocks.prompt:
53 Bromination of phenylamine is faster than that of benzene because the –NH₂ group:
(Phenylamine ki bromination benzene se tez kyun hai?)

options.text: –NH₂ group benzene ring ko deactivate karta hai
–NH₂ group ring ke π electrons hata deta hai
–NH₂ group benzene ring ko kaafi reactive bana deta hai

blocks.explanation: Amino group benzene ring ko kaafi reactive bana deta hai, khaas kar o aur p positions par (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Hence, bromination of phenylamine is faster than benzene

blocks.prompt:
54 The functional group of diazo compounds is:
(Diazo compounds ka functional group kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jin compounds ka functional group diazonium ion –N⁺≡N (diazo group) ho woh diazo compounds hain (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: The organic compounds having diazonium ion, –N⁺≡N (diazo group) as a functional group are called diazo compounds

blocks.prompt:
55 For diazotization, nitrous acid is prepared in situ from:
(Diazotization ke liye nitrous acid mauqa par (in situ) kis se banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrous acid ghair-mustaqil hai aur sodium nitrite aur HCl se mauqa par banaya jata hai (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Nitrous acid is unstable and is prepared in situ by the reaction of sodium nitrite and HCl

blocks.prompt:
56 During diazotization of phenylamine the mixture is kept below 10 °C because:
(Phenylamine ki diazotization mein mixture 10 °C se kam kyun rakha jata hai?)

options.text: diazonium salts ghair-mustaqil hain aur toot kar N₂ chhorte hain
nitrous acid 10 °C se upar jam jata hai
phenylamine 10 °C se upar ubalne lagti hai

blocks.explanation: Diazonium salts ghair-mustaqil hain aur room temperature par bhi aasani se toot kar N₂ chhorte hain (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: The reaction mixture is kept below 10 °C using ice

blocks.prompt:
57 When phenyldiazonium chloride is hydrolysed (warmed with water), the organic product is:
(Phenyldiazonium chloride ki hydrolysis (paani ke saath garam karne) par organic product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenyldiazonium chloride ki hydrolysis phenol deti hai (N₂ nikalti hai) (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Diazotisation of phenylamine and hydrolysis of phenyldiazonium chloride to phenol

blocks.prompt:
58 Which statement about diazonium salts is correct?
(Diazonium salts ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Alkyl diazonium salts aryl se zyada mustaqil hain
Alkyl aur aryl dono room temperature par mustaqil hain
Alkyl diazonium salts alag nahi kiye ja sakte, magar aryl diazonium salts kam temperature par kaafi mustaqil hain
Aryl diazonium salts bilkul nahi banaye ja sakte

blocks.explanation: Alkyl diazonium salts har haal mein bohat ghair-mustaqil hain; aryl diazonium salts kam temperature par kaafi mustaqil hain (24.3.3).

book_ref.quote: The alkyl diazonium salts are highly unstable under all conditions and therefore cannot be isolated

blocks.prompt:
59 The extra stability of aromatic diazonium salts is due to:
(Aromatic diazonium salts ki izafi mustaqili (stability) ki wajah kya hai?)
